rulings.reason: The scored axis is whether the prose reads as freshly composed for this docket versus reusable template language, which is a fingerprint of how the comment was produced (individual submission vs. mass-campaign form letter) rather than of the strength of its evidence or argument; a bespoke but vacuous comment scores 10 and a templated comment carrying real technical substance scores 0. Bespoke authorship does plausibly co-occur with genuine firsthand engagement and better substance, so it belongs in both readouts.
